en: Multiview color postcard of Bucharest showing four sights: the Arcul de Triumf on a broad boulevard with cars and a trolleybus; Mogoșoaia Palace beside a lake with people rowing; the façade and gardens of the Bucharest National Opera; and the Carol Park Mausoleum with an arched bridge and boats on the lake. In the center is the socialist-era coat of arms with the caption "BUCURESTI." The reverse has Romanian postal layout, a "Posta Romana" 40 bani stamp with București cancellations, printed captions, and a handwritten message addressed to Oțelu Roșu, Caraș-Severin.
